Roles.Name: Analyst
Roles.CyberTronianPerk: Work the Numbers: At the begining of every round of combat after the first, you can spend an energon point, to move a creature in combat up or down one place in initiative order.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one rank in two of the following skills: Alertness, finesse,infiltration, iniative, science, or Technology

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are tained in standard Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in one handed weapons, including weapons tha can be used one or two handed.

Perks.Name: Analyze Target
Perks.Effect: You see the enemy as walking datafiles of valuable information. As a standard action make an alertness skill test against the Willpower or Cleverness of a target you can see. On a successs you learn a valuable piece of infomation of yur choice about them. such as their rank in a specific skill, or a defense score.

Perks.Name: Informed Accuracy
Perks.Effect: To know your enememy is to know their weaknesss. When you attack a creature you've used Analyze Target on this Combat, you gain upshift on the attack equal to the times you've used Analyze Target on them'

Perks.Name: Unsurprising
Perks.Effect: Odds are low that you get caught off guard. If you would be Surprised you can act, but instead treat your speed score as if it were equal to your level(up to your actual speed score)

Perk.Name: Data Analyst
Perk.Effect: At 2nd level gain an Edge on Science and Technology Skill test related to extracting or processing data. such as hacking into an enemy computer. IF the extracting process usally takes 2 rounds or longer it takes you half the time

Perks.Name: Determine Probability
Perks.Effect: At 5th level , once per turn, instead of  using a standard action which requires a skill test, you can use a free action to run a simulation of you using that Standard Action. Roll the skill test as if you were actually attempting the Skill Test. If this simulated action succeeds you can use your standard action to use the results of the simulated test instead of making the skill test. On a failure you can ignore the results and use your standard action differently

Perks.Name: Quick Study
Perks.Effect: At 7th level, using Analyze Target is a move action, or Standard Action.

Perks.Name: Pinpoint
Perks.Effect: At 9th level when you use the aim action, instead of 1 upshift on your shot, you can choose to Ignore one of the targets Armor Upgrades for each Free action you spend Aiming.

Perk.Name: Postmortem Interrogation
Perk.Effect: At 12th Level, once per scene, you can extracted information from a defeated cybertronian. Roll a Science or Technology Skill test against a DIF equal to the targets level or threat level. On a success you can ask the GM a question. The Gm must answer truthfully, but from the defeated cybertronians perspective. You may ask another question for every 5 points you exceed the DIF.

Perk.Name: Target Breakdown
Perk.Effect: At 13th level, you can spend a number of free actions equal to the number of times you've used Analyze Target on a target to give an ally upshift on an attack against the target equal to that number

Perk.Name: Psychoanalyst
Perk.Effect: At 14th level as a standard action  you can roll a Science or Technology Skill Test against the Willpower or Cleverness of a target that can hear you. On a sucess the target suffers the Stun 2 effect

Perk.Name: Just the Facts
Perk.Effect: At 16th level you become immune to Deception Skill Tests from creatures your level or lower, and resistance to Deception Skill Test from creatures higher level than you.

Perk.Name: Swift Study
Perk.Effect: At 18th level using Analyze target is a free action. You can use any number of free actions on Analyze Target on a single turn. but you can only target one creature a turn

Roles.Name: FieldCommander
Roles.CyberTronianPerk: Never Forsaken: Once Per Scene, when an ally no further away from you than your fastest movement in alt mode takes Damage, you can spend an Energon Point to move adjacent to that ally, converting if you need to, and take the Damage instead, even if the attack would not normally penetrate your defenses.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one rank in two skills from the follwoing: Brawn, Dception, Intimidation, Might, Performance, or Persuasion

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in limited Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in ballistic weapons and melee weapons

Perk.Name: Issue Command
Perk.Effect: As a move action you can issue a command, granting allies who follow your command an upshift to a skill test or a +1 to Defense based on certain circumstances. You set the terms and the bonus allies recieve,This bonuse last until the begining of your next turn.

Perk.Name: Prepare for War
Perk.Effect: When you roll for Initative and you are not Suprised, you gain an edge on your Initiative skill test

Name.Effect: At 2nd level, as a Standard Action, you can make a perusuasion Skill Test against a target whoese level is no higher than yours. On a sucess give that target a one word order. As long as the order does not put the target in immediate harm, violate one of their core beliefs, and can be accomplished with a move action, they use their move action to follow the command to the best of their abilty on their next turn.

Perk.Name: Synch Up
Perk.Effect: At 5th level once per turn when an ally attacks and misses a target within your range, you can immediately attack that target, even though it is not yoru turn.

Perk.Name: Stoic
Perk.Effect: At 7th level as a move action, you can stand tall for all to see. You take a penealty to eveasion up to -3 and can't defend with Toughness untill the beginning of your nex turn. Your alies each gain a number of Free actions equal to the penalty you took to your Evasion, on their next turn.

Perk.Name: Battle Scan
Perk.Effect: At 9th level, whe nyou roll Initiative,  you learn the Threat Levels of every enemy that you're aware of in this combat.

Perk.Name: Hardened
Perk.Effect: At 12th level you become trained in restricted  Armor Upgrades, and gain +1 health.

Perk.Name: Let Cool Heads Prevail
Perk.Effect: At 13th level, outside of combat, when you role a Social Skill Test with Specialization, you can score a critical sucecess with the d2

Perk.Name: The First Rule of Solidering
Perk.Effect: At 14th level when you roll for Initiative, you can Issue a Command for free

Perk.Name: Complex Command
Perk.Effect: At 15th level, when you issue a command, you can issue two commands. Each command must have different terms and benefits. Allies that meet both terms recieve both benefits

Perk.Name: Stand Together
Perk.Effect: At 18th level, once per scene, as a Standard action, you can make a DIF15 Persuasion Skill Test. On a success, all allies Repair 1 Damage. This is multipled on a Critical Success or a high degree of success
